description: DeFi yield and lending pools across protocols and chains, updated hourly: supply APY (base + reward), borrow APY for lending pools, TVL and what it counts, 50 per page. Filter by chain, token (symbol, name, address or pair), stablecoins only, a minimum TVL (use min_tvl_usd of 1000000 or more to skip thin pools, whose APYs swing), a minimum APY and held_only (yields that held over 30 days). apy_spike marks a supply APY over 3x its 30-day mean; sorted by supply_apy, highest first, those come last. A pool with tvl_kind collateral is a market taking the token as collateral: it pays nothing on it and lends collateral_for (when known) at borrow_apy_pct; for a token, those come after the pools that pay a yield. curated_by marks pools AlphaGrowth runs; it never changes the order. Each pool links to its page with the daily history; yield_pool returns that history. To borrow against a token, use borrow_markets. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

amount_usd.description: The USD value you would deposit: each pool then says what share of it that would be (a deposit over ~10% of a pool moves its APY).

chain.description: The chain: its slug or name (base, Ethereum, unichain, arbitrum, solana).

held_only.description: yes for pools whose APY held: a 30-day mean exists, the APY is at most twice it and at most 100% (spikes and new pools left out).

min_apy.description: The smallest supply APY in percent a pool needs to be listed.

min_tvl_usd.description: The smallest TVL in USD a pool needs to be listed.

sort_order.description: desc for the highest first, asc for the lowest.

token.description: A token: symbol (WETH), name (Ondo Finance), contract address, or a pair (cbBTC-WETH). Matches the token's own pools first, then pools holding it with others; ETH also matches WETH, BTC the wrapped bitcoins.
